ops.en: THE BORDER SACRIFICES. va-yizbach ZEVACHIM l-elohe aviv YITZCHAQ — at Beersheba, the last well of the land, the father who was told 'do not go down' there (26:2, Isaac's own ban) is invoked by his son at the point of going down: the machine files the tension the night- vision answers.

TIMBER TRACKED ACROSS THREE GENERATIONS AND TWO BOOKS [claim G69-29]. The trees the first patriarch planted are cut here by the third, carried down to Egypt, and become the boards of the Tabernacle. This verse is the arc's middle seat, named in advance at an earlier block. The covenant-of-the-tribes sacrifice is read at the same clause. [folded shape: kept record]

THE DOUBLED CALL [G69-02]. YAAQOV YAAQOV... HINENI — the doubled- name call: MS's file counts THREE doubled names in Scripture with the divider stroke (paseq) between them — Abraham-Abraham at the knife (22:11, in-corpus), Jacob-Jacob here, Moses-Moses at the bush (Exod 3:4, armed) — and SNAPSHOT writes the CONNECTOR (munach) at this station, not the divider: the mark-split filed named, the stream…

THE DIVINE FEAR-NOT [G69-01]. AL TIRA me-RDA MITZRAYMA — the fear- not class's highest speaker: God permits what Isaac was forbidden (26:2), and the going-down word wears the directional he — MITZRAYMA, whose Torah census the Ramah fixes at twenty-seven with- the-he tokens, EXACT in-stream [VERIFIED: manifest G69-01]; MS warns off the 'whisperer' (a scribes'-correction variant without the he) by t…

THE ROUND-TRIP. anokhi ERED imkha... ve-anokhi AALKHA gam ALO — the go-down and the bring-up in one breath: the exile signed with its return clause; the doubled rise-verb's final he read by the Kitzur as the five generations down-and-up (Jacob, Levi, Kohath, Amram, Moses — named); ve-YOSEF yashit yado al enekha — the son's hand on the father's eyes: the deathbed promise (the readings on the closin…

THE ASSURANCE IS READ PAST THE INDIVIDUAL [claim G69-24]. 'I will also bring you up' becomes you AND ALL THE RIGHTEOUS LIKE YOU - a private promise turned into a general clause the block's operators must carry. 'Joseph will place his hand on your eyes' is read twice over, as providing for every need and as closing his eyes in death. And the night vision is one of the few places the buffer does NOT…

THE CARRYING. va-yisu vene yisrael et YAAQOV avihem — the sons carry the father (the carry-verb of the burdens); ba-AGALOT asher shalach paro — the wagons of the proof (45:27) now the wagons of the deed: the span's machinery rolls on the king's axles.

THE ARRIVAL. va-YAVOU MITZRAYMA — the come-demand of the king (45:18, gen_68's open summons) meets its arrival-verse: the corpus settlement link carries the discharge (the one-world law — no in- unit RESULT for another unit's queue). MIQNEHEM written FULL — the printed Masorah's tangle untangled by Or Torah with the Hilleli, the Ramah, the Meiri, and Shemen Sason (asserted [G69-12]): the herds of …
ALL HIS SEED. kol zaro HEVI ito — the completeness formula before the ledger: nothing of the house remains behind; the machine reads 46:7 as the census's warrant.

A DESCENT RULE READ OFF HOW A LIST NAMES ITS MEMBERS [claim G69-24]. Sons' daughters count like sons; daughters' sons do not. Extracted from the roster's own phrasing, and it is the rule the count in the next verses actually runs on - the law arrives before the arithmetic that needs it. [folded shape: priced law]

THE LEDGER OPENS. ve-ELE SHEMOT bene yisrael ha-baim MITZRAYMA — the names-header that will open the second book verbatim-shaped (Exod 1:1, armed): the machine installs the section with its four mother- registers; BEKHOR yaaqov REUVEN — the firstborn heads the count his deeds could not forfeit in the ledger's grammar (letter-note).

REUBEN'S FOUR. chanokh u-falu ve-chetzron ve-kharmi — four names; the Enoch-name (chanokh) recurs from the two earlier lines (Cain's city-son, 4:17; the walker, 5:22): the ledger's names carry old freight (letter-note).

SIMEON'S SIX. ve-SHAUL ben ha-KENAANIT — the one mother noted in the whole ledger: the readings ask why hers (named); the Shaul-name wears the full skeleton of G66-06's asking/king/grave file (letter- note).

A CLAIM MADE AT THE GATE COLLECTS HERE. The standing reading that the brother took his sister after the massacre is what this roster entry is held to record - the son listed under a description rather than a name. The ink-observation that only of Rachel is it written 'the children of Rachel, JACOB'S WIFE' also fires on this roster, at 46:19, exactly as its earlier block recorded. [folded shape: ke…

LEVI'S THREE [G69-12]. gershon QEHAT u-merari — Kohath LEAN (no vav) in every book against a printer's emendation (the Masorah's own two- station note for the Numbers pairs proves the point, MS's arithmetic: were the printer right, they would be three); the priest-line's grandfather crosses lean (asserted).

THE DEAD COUNTED. va-YAMAT er ve-onan — the ledger alone among the registers pauses for deaths (gen_61's two struck sons): the count replaces them with Perez's two — the machine notes the arithmetic of the substitution (five minus two plus two).

ISSACHAR'S FOUR [G69-03]. tola U-FUVA — the vav of Puvah's name: Or Torah found it SOFT in the Hilleli and the weighty books (a margin note recording the dispute); Radak's own scribal manual rules the DAGESH — and SNAPSHOT writes the DAGESH: the stream with Radak against the Hilleli's camp — a pointing split carried whole, the stream's side checked in-stream [VERIFIED: manifest G69-03, the split n…
ZEBULUN'S THREE. sered ve-elon ve-yachlel — the sixth son's three; the Elon-name repeats the Hittite father-in-law's (26:34): the ledger's skeleton-collisions keep their file (letter-note).

THIRTY-THREE. sheloshim ve-SHALOSH — the subtotal counts thirty- three where the names count thirty-two: the reading tradition's answers (Yocheved born between the walls; Jacob himself heads his own count) are named, never merged — the machine files the arithmetic tension as the ledger's own open question (letter-fact, the readings named).
GAD'S SEVEN. shiva — the troop-named son musters seven; the ledger's second register opens.
SERAH THEIR SISTER. ve-SERACH achotam — the registers' one named sister besides Dinah: the readings give her the long life and the secret of the redeemer (named); the ledger grants her four words.
SIXTEEN. shesh esre NAFESH — the second register closes; the given- maid formula (asher natan lavan) keeps Laban's hand visible in the count (letter-note).

THE WIFE'S TWO. bene RACHEL eshet yaaqov — the only register headed 'Jacob's WIFE' (the speech's arithmetic at 44:27 — 'my wife bore me two' — becomes the ledger's own heading): Joseph and Benjamin, the count's center of gravity.

THE EGYPTIAN-BORN. va-YIVALED le-yosef — the two names gen_64's registry installed (menashe, efrayim) enter the ledger from the far side: the count reaches across the border it is crossing; the two- word priest-name (poti fera) keeps its two unjoined tokens (G64-09's law, letter-note).

BENJAMIN'S TEN [G69-04]. the 'lad' of the speeches musters TEN sons — the ledger's quiet correction of the court's grammar; VA-ROSH — the head-name's skeleton stands TWICE in the Torah: Benjamin's son and the Song's 'VENOM of serpents' (Deut 32:33, the poison- homograph); the Kitzur's Scripture-pair is Lamentations' wormwood- and-poison (Lam 3:19, named) — he reads all ten names as Joseph- memoria…
FOURTEEN. kol nefesh ARBAA ASAR — two sons, twelve grandsons: the smallest register's largest yield-per-name; the ledger's arithmetic favors the beloved (letter-note).

THE PLURAL OF ONE [G69-05]. u-VENE dan CHUSHIM — 'the SONS of Dan: Hushim' — one name under a plural header: one of the Masorah's four presumed-singular (sevirin) cases — readers presume 'the son'; the letter writes the plural and the Masorah locks it (the Talmud's reed-thicket homily on the name, named by the Kitzur: one root, many stems) [VERIFIED: manifest G69-05]; u-vene joined by the maqqef w…

A PLURAL HEADING OVER A SINGLE NAME, WITH THE NEXT VERSE AS CONTROL [claim G69-22, machine-checked]. One of the five answers to the missing member reads the plural 'and the SONS of Dan' over one son as licensing a double count. Verified: this verse carries exactly three tokens - plural heading, tribe, one name - while the very next verse puts the identical heading over FOUR. THE OTHER LEG IS DECLA…
NAPHTALI'S FOUR. ve-SHILEM — the name whose skeleton collided with the lean-shalom file (gen_55's crown): the ledger seats the collision's other member (letter-note).
SEVEN. kol nefesh SHIVA — the fourth register closes: 33 + 16 + 14 + 7 — the mothers' arithmetic stands ready for the two totals.

SIXTY-SIX [G69-06]. kol ha-nefesh HA-BAA — the coming-word END- STRESSED (one of the Masorah's three such): the coming still in motion — the caravan is on the road as the verse counts it; its twin two lines down will wear the OPPOSITE stress [VERIFIED: manifest G69-06]. shishim va-shesh — the sixty-six of the loins, wives excluded by the letter's own clause.

SEVENTY [G69-06 CLOSED]. kol ha-nefesh... HA-BAA — the same word, FORE-STRESSED (one of the Masorah's three such): the coming completed — the house counted as arrived; MS's own mnemonic seals the adjacent pair: 'the upper one above, the lower one below' [VERIFIED under G69-06: both strokes checked in-stream]. SHIVIM — the seventy that the nation's memory will carry (Exod 1:5, Deut 10:22, armed): t…

THE SHORTFALL IS IN OUR INK, AND FIVE ANSWERS STAND UNRANKED [claim G69-21, machine-checked]. Sixty-six cups and three more counted as seventy - the chain states the problem as sharply as it can be stated. Machine-checked: the previous verse closes at SIXTY-SIX, this verse gives Joseph's sons as TWO and then declares SEVENTY. The numbers do not close. Five candidates are recorded for the missing m…

A ROSTER'S ARITHMETIC DELIVERS A RULE ABOUT HANDING OVER A LIFE [claim G69-23]. Following the woman who completed the count, the passage carries her whole case: a besieged group must NOT deliver one soul of Israel even on pain of all being killed - UNLESS he was singled out BY NAME. With it the inside-outside distinction, the rule on revolt against the house of David, and the two cases that test t…

JUDAH AHEAD [G69-07]. ve-et YEHUDA shalach lefanav... LE-HOROT — the point-the-way word written LEAN, exactly TWICE so in the Torah: Judah's errand and the law's own 'to TEACH' (Lev 14:57, the leprosy- code's close): the readings split the errand (to clear a path / to found a house of teaching, named) and the letter's one twin votes with the teachers [VERIFIED: manifest G69-07]. GOSHNA — the distr…

ONE UNPOINTED WORD, TWO INSTITUTIONS [claim G69-27]. The chain hears 'to TEACH' and founds the first house of study on it, before Sinai; the translation reads the same consonants as 'to CLEAR A PLACE in Goshen,' a billeting detail. Neither can be settled from the ink, because both take the identical letters. Recorded as a total split with no promotion. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE HARD BINDING [G65-05 CLOSED; G68-02 CLOSED]. va-YESOR yosef merkavto — the bind-verb with the alef in BARE SHEVA: the Masorah's hard binding, exactly as armed at Simeon's soft one (42:24 chataf- segol against this; Pharaoh's chase-binding, Exod 14:6, still ahead) — the file's second station lands in-stream [VERIFIED: manifest G69-08]. va-yipol al TZAVARAV... va-yevk al TZAVARAV OD — the neck- …

LOVE UPSETS THE ORDER, AT ITS THIRD SEAT IN THE CORPUS. The standing rule read from a patriarch saddling his own donkey fires again here, where the viceroy of Egypt harnesses his own chariot to go up and meet his father. Quick-looked at this verse; the rule holds and mints nothing new. [folded shape: kept record]

THE RESOLVE MET. AMUTA ha-paam — 'let me die THIS TIME': 45:28's before-I-die resolve (elkha ve-erenu be-terem amut) is paid in full sight; ki ODKHA CHAI — the still-alive clause (ha-od avi chai, 45:3; odenu chai, 43:28) lands in the second person: the question of the whole cycle answered to the face it asked about.

THE TRANSLATION WILL NOT LET THE PATRIARCH ASK FOR DEATH [claim G69-28]. 'NOW LET ME DIE, after I have seen your face' becomes 'IF I were to die now, I WOULD BE CONSOLED' - a conditional supplied and the wish turned into comfort. One of the buffer's standing habits, visible at its last occasion in the narrative. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE BRIEFING. EELE ve-AGIDA le-faro — the governor scripts the audience before it happens (as he scripted the trial): the machine notes the pattern — Joseph's power is stage-management; the tell- verb full per the G65-06 law (letter-note).

THE OCCUPATION. roe TZON... anshe MIQNE — the shepherd-word said plainly in the family briefing (the abomination-clause waits two verses): the machine files the two-audience strategy — truth to the house, framing for the throne.
THE ANTICIPATION. ki YIQRA lakhem paro — the governor predicts the king's question verbatim (47:3 will quote it back, armed): the machine notes the script's third act written before its performance.

THE SCRIPTED ANSWER [G69-12]. VA-AMARTEM anshe MIQNE hayu avadekha — the say-demand pushed on the whole house: the answer scripted two scenes early, OPEN at the span's end (47:3's performance is the settlement in waiting, ARMED for the next run); baavur TESHVU be- eretz GOSHEN — the goal-clause names the stakes; ki TOAVAT mitzrayim kol roe tzon — the abomination-fact (the meal's partition, 43:32, …

THE SAME EUPHEMIZING MOVE AS THE SEPARATE TABLES, HELD TO THE END [claim G69-28]. 'An ABOMINATION to Egypt' becomes 'the Egyptians KEEP DISTANT from every shepherd.' The buffer made this exact move three chapters earlier and has not relaxed it. Where at the tables it supplied the cult reason, here it states only the practice. [folded shape: dual-track translation]
